book.name: Mark
book.title: Rongmwehu ma insingdi jang ipen Mark

content: Koajoanpen Kojkojdihn Jesus
Rehn riauwoar luhwoa mwohn Joarwihn Passover apel Pilahwa Joah Doal Ihs. Jamwrou laplap apel jounpadahk in Kojonneddok raprapahki doahr irai en widingehdi apel joalihdi Jesus pwa irai en kojukdi.
Irai ken pwahpene nehn pwungarai, “Kisai joah wia anjoau in kamdipw oauwe, pwadoar armaj kan loakloakoahkihda.”
Jesus Salipekla nehn Bethany

Jesus minmine nehn Bethany nehn umwen Simon, woal lepahu. Nehn irai mwingmwinge, lihmen dilda ipoa, wa rume siksik oau ma dirin le ma inenin karahdin apel koalik dupkoa, ma wiawi jang in pwilin suhkoa ma adanki nard. Liho ken koauwehla rume siksikko widekihdihoang pohn moangoan Jesus.
Epwi ma pwili mine wijahu ken lioasla pwahpene nehn pwungarai, “Amwda le karahdin oauwe ken ohla mwahl?
Nehn ah kakkoar noasla in mwani silper jilipwiki mihn jeuweje irai ma paijuwed.” Irai ken liplipahnedi liho.
Jesus pwa,

content.text: “Kamwai pijekjang! Kamwai joah diroapwki lihe! Siahk mwehu, oau me ih wiahng Ngoahi.
Irai ma paijuwed kan kin minminehr ipamwai rehn ohroj; doari anjoau ohroj ma kamwai mwehuki, kamwai kak jeuweje irai; a Ngoahi, Ngoahi jehpirin pwilpwili kamwai anjoau ohroj.
Ih ne wiahda uhwen ma ih kak: Ih wiahda soal oauwe oang palwoaroaioa pwa en koaunopda dahkij ma pirin wiawihoang Ngoahi mwohn oai pirin joajjoardi.
Doari, kamwai en kidal pwa wija ohroj nehn jampah ma Rongmwehu pirin lel dahkij ma ih ne wiahda pirin pel pwili lohkjili pwa en kin wia mihn kasman Ngoahi.”

content: Judas Pwungkihla en Pangla Jesus
Judas Iscariot, emen irai eijek roahmenno, ken inla ipen jamwrou laplappok pwa en panngoang irai Jesus.

Irai ken perenkihda dahkij Judas pwehng irai. Irai ken inoaukihoang ih pwa irai pirin dupukki mwani. Doari, jang nehn anjoauwo johpwa me Judas nimen wia, ioarroar en kidalda anjoau mwehu ih en kak pangla Jesus.
Jesus apel Nah Sohnpadahkkok Mwingehpene nehn Kamdipw in Passover

Nehn keiouin rehnin Joarwihn Pilahwa Joah Doal Ihs, rehnno ma irai kin kalap kojukdi jihpw pwulopwul in Passover, nihn Jesus sohnpadahkkok ken pwehng, “Ia wija Koawoa nimen kamai en koaunopda Oamw kamdipw in Passover‑o?”
Jesus ken kadarla ara roahmen, pwehng,

content.text: “Kamwa alwe nehn kahnihmmwen; kamwa pirin suhwoang woal men ma wahwahwa dohn pil oau. Kamwa ken kaujwe.

Wija ma ih pirin dilda, kamwa pel dilda kamwa pwehng koaun in ummwo pwa Jounpadahkko iloakihdo pwa kama en idoak ipoamw, ‘Ia pere ma Ngoahi apel Noai sohnpadahkkok pirin wia amai kamdipw in Passover?’
A ih pirin kajalehioang kamwa pere koalik oau puwoa, ma ne koajoanjoandi apel koaunopda. Doari, kamwa koaunopda joang ohroj wijahu.”

content: Sohnpadahkkok lella nehn kahnihmmwo; ira kidalda me ohroj doahr ma Ih pwehng ira. Ara ken koaunopda me ohroj.
Injoausikpene, Jesus apel Nah sohnpadahk eijek roahmenno inla Jerusalem.
Nehn irai mwingmwinge in sehpillo, Jesus pwehng irai,

content.text: “Ngoahi pwehng kamwai in mehlel, pwa emen kamwai pirin pangla Ngoahi emen ma pwili Ngoahi mwingmwinge me.”

content: Sohnpadahkkok ken pwunodkihda lalloauwe, irai ken sapda wademen idoak ipoa, “Maing, ngoahi ma koawoa pwahki lalloauwe?”
Jesus japoang,

content.text: “Eh, emen jang kamwai eijek roahmen pwiai, emen ma pwili kadkadu kanah pilahwahu nehn Oai mwoakke.
Mehlel pwa Nihn-Armaj uhdahn pirin mehdi doahroar Puk Joarwi ne pwa, nen naunahng armajjo ma pirin pangla Nihn-Armaj! Mwehuwoanngoar armaj mene en johpwa noaisikdi!”

content: En Koaunno Kamdipw Joarwi
Nehn anjoauwo ma irai mwingmwinge Jesus kihda pilahwahioau kapingkalahnganki oang Koahs, sipwangpijoang kioang Nah sohnpadahkkok, pwehng,

content.text: “Kamwai oaloa, pwa ioar palwoaroaioahwa me.”

content: Ih pel oaloa mwoak oau kapingkalahnganki oang Koahs, kioang irai. Irai ohroj ken pwili nimjang.
Ih pel pwa,

content.text: “Ioar insahihoawa me ma pirin widekdihoang armaj ohroj, insahihoa ma pirin kadehde en Koahs Inoau Kapw.
Ngoahi pwehng kamwai in mehlel, pwa jang mwerin rehnnoauwe, Ngoahi johla pirin pwuroahng nim wain oaroh lel rehnno ma Ngoahi pirin pwuroahng nim wain kapw nehn wein Koahs.”

content: Mwerin irai koaulki koaul pas, irai ken allaluhlahng in Dolin Olip.
Jesus Kohpda en Peter ah pirin kahmahmkihla Ih
Jesus ken pwehng irai,

content.text: “Kamwai ohroj pirin kaupijoang apel kerpwihla Ngoahi, pwa Puk Joarwi ne pwa, ‘Koahs pirin kojukdi jiloapoahu, a jihpw kan pirin kaupijoang.’
A mwerin Oai pirin iejda, Ngoahi pirin inla mwohmwai Galilee.”

content: Peter japoang Jesus, “Maing, mihnda ma ohroj pirin kerpwihla koawoa, a ngoahioahr joah!”
Jesus pwehng Peter,

content.text: “Ngoahi pwehng koawoa in mehlel, pwa pwongoauwe, mwohn joang jummwa kariau, koawoa pirin kahmahmkihla Ngoahi pehn jiluh, pwa koawoa jehjoa Ngoahi.”

content: A Peter japoang Jesus, in ngil sihkei, “Ngoahi johpwa pirin kahmahmki pwa ngoahi jehjoa koawoa, Maing, mihnda ma ngoahi pel pwili koawoa mehdi.” Doari, sohnpadahkkok ohroj pel pwili wia joangoan sikesikkoauwe.
Jesus Kapkap nehn Mwoaswel Gethsemane
Irai lel nehn mwoaswel ma adanki Gethsemane. Jesus ken pwehng Nah sohnpadahkkok,

content.text: “Kamwai mwindi, pwa Ngoahi pirin kapkap.”

content: Ih ken ukda Peter, James apel John. Ih injinjuwedla apel pahsoaula,
Ih ken pwehng irai,

content.text: “Nehn kapehdihoa inenin pwunodda doahrma Ngoahi pirin mehdi. Kamwai jowi Ngoahi me johpwa moairla.”

content: Ih ken inla ekij dohlahjang irai, poadpwomwla pohn pwirej kapkapki ma awahn loklokko johkak dauluhl jang Ih.
Ih ken pwa,

content.text: “Pahpa, Pahpa, me ohroj kak ipoamw. Koawoa kihwehjang Ngoahi dal oauwe. A joah, jaudi injenoai en pwoaida, pwa dahkij Koawoa kupwurki ioar en pwoaida.”

content: Ih ken japahldo ipen irai jilmenno kidalda pwa irai moair. Ih ken pwehng Peter,

content.text: “Simon, koawoa moair? Koawoa joh kak pwili poahpoahpoahdki awa oauwoar?”

content: Ih ken pwehng irai,

content.text: “Kamwai pwili poahd apel kapkap pwa doar kamwai lohdihoang nehn jongjong. Pwa ngen ma peik a palwar ma jasihkei.”

content: Ih pel japahlla kapkap, in joangoan mwommwohr.
Ih ken pel japahldohng ipen Nah sohnpadahkkok kidalda pwa irai moahmoahmoair, pwa mijaraihok inenin soausoaukihla arai nimen moair. Irai ken jehjoahla pwa da irai en pwehng Jesus.
Mwerin, kajiluh in Ah pwurla iparai, Ih pwehng irai,

content.text: “Kamwai ken moair koamkoammoal? Ne isar! Awahu ne leldo, ma ioar Nihn-Armaj pirin pangpangla ipen irai dipan kan.
Kamwai pwohrda! Kisai! Kapang, ioar armaj wa ma pirin pangla Ngoahi ne leldo.”

content: Jesus ne Joaldi

Jesus kahjik kadoarihla Ah sikesik, a Judas, emen arai eijek roahmenno, lel Ipoa. Pokon koalikkoau ma pwili; irai wijik kodlaij apel koapwoahn pei, indoahjang ipen jamwrou laplappok, jounpadahk in kojonneddok apel koaunnok.
Judas kioang pokonno kilel oau, pwa, “Armajjo ma Ngoahi pirin misik, ioar Ih, kamwai joalihdi. Kamwai ukwe jiloa Ih.”
Nehn en Judas lel wijahu, ih ken inlahng ipen Jesus, pwehng, “Rabbi!”
ih ken misik Jesus.
Pokonno ken koldi Jesus joalihdi Ih soang.
A emen iraihok ma mine wijahu, wijda nah kodlaijjo ngap pijoang poaloahjang sien nihn emen Jamwrou Laplappo lidu.
Jesus ken pwehng irai,

content.text: “Imdoahr, kamwai indoahng koldi Ngoahi wijik jahr apel koapwoahn pei, doahr ma Ngoahi pwen lollap nauna men?
Rehn ohroj Ngoahi kin minminehr ipamwai, padpadahk nehn Umw Joarwiho, kamwai johpwa joalihdi Ngoahi. Doari, me pirin wiawi pwa lalin Puk Joarwi en pwoaida.”

content: Nah sohnpadahkkok ohroj ken kerpwihla Ih kaula.
Mwahnkapw men pwili kauj Jesus; pidkihpene palwoaroa upuhp oau. Irai jong in koldi ih.
Ih kaula kiljoau, kaujang ah likkoauwo.
Jesus Uhda Mwohn Mwoalen Koapwunngo
Irai ken uklahng Jesus in umwen Jamwrou Laplappo, wija ma ohroj jamwrou laplappok, koaunnok apel jounpadahk in Kojonneddok pokonpene.
Peter pwen kahkahkaujjoar Jesus a ekij dohlahjang, oaroh lel nehn kelin umwen Jamwrou Laplappo. Ih ken mwindihoang wija ipen jounpei pwi pwa ih en pwili irai koaroangroang ipen oaiho.
Jamwrou laplappok apel Sohn Mwoalen Koapwung ohroj ken engdehnkihla rapahkihda kadehdehpwi ma pirin kahrehioang Jesus en kojkojdi, irai ken johpwa diar.
Dirin jounkadehde pwi kinehioang Jesus likamw pwi, a arai kadehde kan johpwa pwungpene.
Armaj pwi uhda ken kinehioang Jesus likamw oauwe,
“Kamai pein rongjang woalmene, pwa, Ngoahi pirin koauwehla Umw Joarwihe, ma armaj kouda, a mwerin rehn jiluh Ngoahi pirin kouda oau ma johpwa wiawihkihda poahn armaj.”
A pel arai sikesik kan johpwa pwungpene.
Jamwrou Laplappo ken uhda jang nehn dohiahu mwohrai ohroj, ih ken idoak ipen Jesus, “Johpwa mehkij koawoa pirin japoangki kadip pwiai ma wiawihoang koawoa?”
Jesus nennenla, johpwa japoang, Jamwrou Laplappo ken pel pwuroahng idoak ipoa, “Koawoa ma Messiah,
Nihn Koahs Kapaiho?”
Jesus ken japoang,

content.text: “Ioar Ngoahi ma Ih; kamwai ohroj pirin kapang Nihn-Armaj Ah pirin mine in loap moaunin Wija Laplap apel ma allaluhdo pohn koasoau kan in pehnloannge.”

content: Jamwrou Laplappo ken uhdahr soahrpijoang ah likkoauwo, ken pwahla, “Kisai johpwa anahne pel epwi jounkadehde!
Kamwai ne pein rong Ah lahlahwe. Dahkij kamwai lemleme?” Irai ohroj ken pwa Ih ne dipda doari Ih koanoahng kojkojdi.
Epwi irai ken sapda andipoa, poaroahla mijoa, poki, apel idoak, “Kohpda pwa inje ma poki koawoa?” Jounpeihok ukla Ih poki.
En Peter Kahmahmki Jesus
Nehn en Peter minmine ijoan nehn kelin umwen Jamwrou Laplappo, lidu jerpein in Jamwrou Laplap men lel wijahu.
Nehn ah kapangda Peter pwili koaroangroang wijahu, ih ken kapkapang Peter, pwehnglahng, “Koawoa pel emen ioangoan Jesus mihn Nazareth.”
Peter ken kahmahmkihla, pwa, “Ngoahi jehjoa… Ngoahi jehjoa dahkij koawoa pwahpwahpwa.” Ih ken dilla nehn palanngo; nehn anjoauwohr joang jummwa keiou wiawi.
Lidu jerpeinno pel pwuroahng kapangda ih wijahu pwehnglahng iraihok ma minmine wijahu, “Uhdahn emen irai me.”
Peter pel pwuroahng kahmahmkihla. Mwerin anjoaukij, irai ma minmine wijahk pel pwehng, “Koawoa johkak kahmahmki pwa koawoa emen kijehrai, pwa koawoa mihn Galilee.”
Peter ken pwahla, “Ngoahi kahukihla pwa ngoahi lallal mehlel! Koahs en koalkoa ngoahi ma ngoahi likamw. Ngoahi jehjoa armaj menen ma kamwai pwahpwahpwa.”
Nehn anjoauwohr joang jummwa kariau wiawi. Peter ken samanda en Jesus pwehng ih,

content.text: “Mwohn joang jummwa kariau pirin wiawi, koawoa pirin kahmahmki Ngoahi pehn jiluh pwa koawoa jehjoa Ngoahi.”

content: Ih ken sapda joang.
